title: Schedule an automatic Defender scan

parameters.name: time
parameters.label: Time
parameters.description: Time in HH:mm:ss format (e.g. 02:00:00 for 2 a.m.)

examples.description: Schedule a daily scan at 2 a.m.
Schedule a scan every Saturday at 8 p.m.
Quick scan every Sunday at noon (ScanParameters: 1=Quick, 2=Full)

notes: ScanScheduleDay: 0=Every day, 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, 3=Tuesday, 4=Wednesday, 5=Thursday, 6=Friday, 7=Saturday, 8=Never. ScanParameters: 1=QuickScan (recommended), 2=FullScan. Pick a time when the PC is on but little used.
